## उत्तर (primary cellular mechanism — CBD/cisplatin combination, group 9)
**DNA-damage / genotoxic-stress signalling with p53-dependent cell-cycle checkpoint arrest** — अर्थात Reactome-स्तर पर "DNA Damage / Cell Cycle Checkpoints" + "TP53 Regulates Transcription of …" वाली anti-proliferative biology: p53/DDR targets up + mitotic/E2F program down, apoptotic priming (BAX/FAS) के साथ। Subordinate second component = CBD-driven **AhR/xenobiotic metabolism** (CYP1A1, AHRR, CYP1B1, TIPARP)।
⚠️ Important honesty note: मांगी गई **gseapy + Reactome_2022 enrichment इस runner में चलाई नहीं जा सकी** (नीचे blocker evidence) — उत्तर validated DEG analysis + transparent hand-listed batteries से निकाला गया *inference* है, कोई literal gseapy term-string या Reactome FDR नहीं; कोई term/FDR fabricate नहीं किया। Script `$REACTOME_GMT` मिलते ही असली result दे देगी।

## (a) DEG tables + counts (approved rules: all-zero drop → fit → baseMean>10 → |LFC|>0.5 → nominal p<0.05; up∪down)
Filtered universe = 16,513 gene records (35,723 tested, 27,954 all-zero dropped; 15,865 symbol-mapped)।
- **combo9 vs Untreated**: 2,619 DEG records = **2,233 unique symbols (up 1,402 / down 1,217)**; padj<0.05 sensitivity 2,274 rows/1,973 symbols
- **combo9 vs DMSO (vehicle)**: 2,241 = **1,938 (1,198/1,043)**; padj 1,885/1,677 — दोनों references में **1,535 shared symbols**
- combo vs Cis 1,543 | combo vs CBD 1,246 | Cis vs Untreated 732 | CBD vs Untreated 806 | combo10 vs DMSO_SS 2,509 | combo10 vs combo9 361
Files: `results/DEG_<contrast>.csv` + `results/DEG_<contrast>_symbols.txt` (ready gseapy input), full tables `results/de_results_<contrast>.csv.gz`।

## (b) Reactome_2022/gseapy enrichment table — नहीं बना (real blocker, कोई fabrication नहीं)
`results/enrichment_STATUS.json = ENRICHMENT_NOT_RUNNABLE`। Evidence: `import gseapy` → ModuleNotFoundError; `pip install gseapy|pydeseq2` → DNS failure; raw-IP TCP (8.8.8.8:53) → "Network is unreachable"; `find / -xdev -iname '*.gmt' -o -iname '*reactome*'` → 0 hits; कोई wheel/pip-cache/R नहीं। `analysis/run_enrichment.py` exit=3 के साथ रुकता है; `$REACTOME_GMT=Reactome_2022.gmt` सेट करके दोबारा चलाने पर वही validated ORA दोनों backgrounds (gseapy library-default + expressed universe n=15,858) के लिए tables बना देगा।

## (c) Redundancy-aware summary (marker-panel diagnostic — explicitly NOT Reactome)
Validated hypergeometric ORA (=scipy fisher_exact), background 15,858 symbols, combo vs Untreated | vs DMSO:
1. **p53/DDR UP** — 14/27 (p 7.2e-6, FDR 1.0e-4) | 15/27 (p 1.6e-7, FDR 2.3e-6); median LFC +0.55/+0.55; CDKN1A +1.16/+1.31, GDF15 +1.74/+1.98, TP53I3, FAS, TIGAR, ZMAT3, TP53INP1, BTG2, RRM2B, FDXR, RPS27L, BAX, PLK3, AEN, PHLDA3, MDM2।
2. **E2F/mitotic cell cycle DOWN** — 13/30 (p 1.6e-4) | 15/30 (p 9.9e-7); median −0.38/−0.36; MKI67 −0.66/−0.75, PLK1, TOP2A, AURKB, CCNB1, BIRC5, FOXM1। **single agents में 0/30 DEG** (Cis −0.03, CBD +0.09) → combination-specific। 1+2 एक ही coherent theme बनाते हैं (nested redundancy collapse किया)।
3. **AhR/xenobiotic UP** — 6/12 (p 4.4e-3 | 1.3e-2), median +0.32; CBD monotherapy के बराबर → drug-specific, combo-specific नहीं।
4. ER-stress/ATF4-flavoured proteostasis केवल combo-vs-cisplatin में (13/32, p 7.1e-6; vs control FDR 0.14; DDIT3/CHOP −1.39 DOWN) → primary नहीं। 5. NRF2 (p 0.16), apoptosis battery (0.28), NF-κB, autophagy, IFN, HSP/proteasome, OXPHOS, NER core (median −0.005) → नहीं। padj<0.05 list पर वही ranking (p53 2.3e-8, cell-cycle 1.5e-7) → threshold-robust।

## (d) Combination specificity
combo 2,233 vs Cis 732 / CBD 806; shared 392 (Jaccard 0.152) और 513 (0.203); **1,464 combo-only**। DDR mostly cisplatin-driven पर CBD से potentiated (combo-vs-Cis: GDF15 +1.02, TP53I3 +0.64, battery median −0.05 = largely shared), जबकि mitotic/E2F shutdown पूर्णतः combo-specific (0/30 single-agent DEG बनाम 13–15/30)।

## Validation + robustness (numbers)
- मेरा DESeq2-equivalent NB GLM: loglik = scipy.nbinom (max diff 6.2e-11); dispersion MLE = scipy optimizer (0/30 mismatch); real-data betas/SE/Wald p = independent NB refit (max |ΔLFC| 0.014, |ΔSE| 0.001); ORA p = fisher_exact, BH OK, planted-signal pass।
- Permutation null (12–20×): mean ~690–750, median ~570–613, max 1,688 pseudo-DEG vs observed 2,233–2,619 → test calibrated, पर nominal-p list ~25–30% inflated।
- Pseudo-null Untreated vs DMSO = 420 DEG → DMSO inert नहीं; इसीलिए उत्तर दोनوں references के intersection पर आधारित (आपका suggestion लागू किया गया; दोनوں में वही theme)।
- Serum starvation dominant covariate (2,566–2,727 DEG) → group 10 secondary।
- LOO shallow replicates: drop 9_2 → 2,956 DEG, 10_1 → 2,640, 3_1 → 2,644 (primary से कोई sample drop नहीं किया)।

## Limitations
Reactome library/गseapy unavailable → enrichment inference है, literal result नहीं; dispersion trend/shrinkage DESeq2 का approximation है (outlier replacement व independent filtering नहीं) → borderline genes shift हो सकते हैं; 3.9% baseMean>10 genes unmapped (symbol libraries में अदृश्य); ENSG→symbol 1:1, collisions केवल 3 symbols; single batch, n=3/group।
